titre: Control Test n°2 — English (6th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Read the text:
Mr Salah is a doctor. He works in a big hospital in Sfax. Every day, he wakes up early and drives to work. He helps sick people and gives them medicine. His wife, Mrs Amel, is a teacher. She teaches English at a primary school. Right now, Mr Salah is examining a patient and Mrs Amel is writing on the board. They love their jobs very much.

Answer:
1) What is Mr Salah's job? (1 pt)
2) Where does he work? (1 pt)
3) What does Mrs Amel do? (1,5 pt)
4) What is Mr Salah doing right now? (1,5 pt)

Complete with the present simple or present continuous:
1) He (work) ...... in a hospital every day.
2) Look! She (write) ...... on the board now.
3) They (love) ...... their jobs.
4) Right now, the doctor (examine) ...... a patient.
5) Mrs Amel (teach) ...... English.

Match each job with the place:
1) doctor    a) school
2) teacher   b) hospital
3) farmer    c) restaurant
4) cook      d) farm

Put the words in the right order:
1) a / is / He / doctor / . 
2) hospital / works / in / He / a / . 
3) English / teaches / She / .

Writing:
Write 3 to 4 sentences about a job you like (the job, the place, what the person does).

More jobs.
Match the job with the place. Write the letter.
1) nurse
2) engineer
3) police officer
a) office
b) hospital
c) street
